title: steps/toolCallRequest payload
description: Payload for the toolCallRequest hook. Fires before tool execution. Primary enforcement gate.

operation.description: Optional sub-operation when the tool exposes multiple verbs

capability.description: Abstract capability identifier (e.g., filesystem.delete, network.egress, process.execute)

arguments.description: Tool arguments. Under provenance_producer: deterministic, each argument value carries its own provenance (ACS-Provenance).

provenance.description: OPTIONAL in the base schema; REQUIRED on every argument under provenance_producer: deterministic (ACS-Provenance). Validate against tool-call-request.acs-provenance.json when the profile is claimed. See Specification section 7.

raw_command.description: Optional shell-style command string for tools that accept one

intent.description: Optional natural-language framing of why the tool is being called
